title: The tide

data.source: NOAA CO-OPS station 9414290 (San Francisco), hourly water level and harmonic predictions, Jan to Mar 2023

prediction: For the height of March high waters, NOAA's harmonic prediction has less than half the RMSE of the seed rule (P1); and for the weather's leftover the seed does not beat persistence by more than 5% (P2).
baseline: NOAA's harmonic tide prediction, persistence, and the running mean.
why: We expected the harmonic prediction to win easily. It did not: a seed that follows the two daily high waters separately beat the bare harmonic prediction, because that month was stormy and the seed sees recent water. But the fair standard forecast, harmonic plus the last tide's leftover, beat the seed by nearly two to one. The seed is an ordinary running average here; the Moon still does the real work.
